protocol: Preregistered BEFORE the first verantyx.connective_render.render_diff call. Five readability axes for designer eyeball of three verbatim renders (hit pair / abstention pair / pair with 一方). Gold is this file; the renderer is not consulted while this block is authored. Scoring is 1 or 0 per axis; fluency is out of scope.
seed_note: Axes are the contract's audit questions, not read from a prior render.

axes.label: subject named
axes.check: Both query subjects appear in the render text by name (the asked A and B, not a paraphrase).

axes.label: buckets distinguishable
axes.check: A reader can tell the three bundles apart: exclusive items carry 実測あり on one side and 実測なし on the other; shared items carry 実測あり on both; そして stays inside a bucket; 一方 marks only_a→only_b; また introduces shared. A typed abstention names the silence instead of assembling a fake DIFF.

axes.label: no negation assembled
axes.check: Outside 「」 quotes the renderer did not build でない / ではない / られない / しない. A ¬-prefixed token quoted verbatim is testimony, not assembly.

axes.label: coverage spoken on abstention
axes.check: INSUFFICIENT_PROFILE and AMBIGUOUS_SENSE texts speak both sides' predicate count and both sides' facet count. A DIFF/RENDER text is exempt (coverage rides the dict).

axes.label: connectives licensed
axes.check: Every そして / また / 一方 / しかし in the text has a matching license record. No connective is placed where the diff structure (or an observed ¬ pair) does not license it.

eyeball_slots: pair whose text contains 一方
